title: Nourishing Umami Malaysian Broad Beans Tagine
description: A flavorful and nutritious Malaysian dish featuring broad beans in a rich umami sauce, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot and finished with a melted cheese pull, perfect for a quick and easy dinner
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the tagine pot over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute
Add the broad beans, umami paste, coconut milk, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes
Remove the lid and stir in the shredded cheese until melted and well combined
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired
Let it rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together
